title: O(n*m) Vec::contains in capability attenuation check
rationale: Added use std::collections::HashSet; and built parent_*_set before each child-iteration loop in check_policy_attenuation. Replaced Vec::contains with HashSet::contains for all three allowlist sections (allowed_tools, allowed_resources, allowed_data_classes). O(n+m) per call, down from O(n*m).
variants_checked: policy.rs:check_policy_attenuation — all three sites fixed; capability/index.rs — uses BTreeMap, different pattern, not affected
bypass_considered: 500-child vs 500-parent: was 250k comparisons, now 500+500=1000 ops. HashSet::contains semantically identical to Vec::contains for exact String equality
test_note: 6 regression tests added to test_policy.rs covering all three allowlist sections with passing subset and failing escalation cases at 500-element scale
review_reason: All three production hunks confined to check_policy_attenuation in policy.rs:156-235, replacing Vec::contains (O(m) per lookup) with pre-built HashSet lookup (O(1)). HashSet populated from already-validated policy fields; no new input surface opened; wildcard guards and combined cls=='*'||!set.contains(cls) predicate in allowed_data_classes both preserved intact.
